question: Who joined as the Mission Director of Atal Innovation Mission under NITI Aayog in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepak Bagla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deepak Bagla** was appointed as the **Mission Director of Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)** under **NITI Aayog** in **2025**. AIM is a flagship initiative by the Government of India to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship across the country.
 
• Deepak Bagla is a prominent figure with vast experience in investment promotion, entrepreneurship, and policy advisory roles. His appointment aligns with AIM's objective to foster innovation in India.
 
• The **Atal Innovation Mission** aims to establish **Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs)** in schools, promote innovation hubs, and encourage startups and small businesses to explore cutting-edge technologies.
 
• Bagla has previously been associated with leadership roles in organizations like **Invest India**, where he contributed significantly to attracting foreign investments into India.
 
• The appointment of Deepak Bagla is expected to further enhance AIM's outreach and strengthen the innovation ecosystem in India, ensuring support for startups and fostering technological advancements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM):**

 
 
• AIM was launched by **NITI Aayog** in **2016** to promote innovation and entrepreneurship across the country.
 
• It focuses on creating a strong innovation ecosystem by establishing **Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs)** in schools and supporting startups and incubators.
 
• AIM also works to foster public-private partnerships in technology and innovation to address critical challenges in sectors like health, education, and agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Deepak Bagla's Contributions:**
 
 
• He served as the **Managing Director and CEO of Invest India**, where he played a key role in promoting foreign direct investment (FDI) into India.
 
• Bagla has extensive experience in the corporate world, having worked with leading organizations like **World Bank** and **Citibank**.
 
• His expertise lies in strategic planning, innovation-driven growth, and policy implementation, making him an ideal choice for leading AIM.
 
 
 
• **Invest India:**
 
 
• Invest India is the national investment promotion and facilitation agency of India, set up under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**.
 
• It focuses on attracting and facilitating investments and has been instrumental in improving India's ease of doing business ranking globally.
 
 
 
• **Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs):**
 
 
• These are dedicated innovation workspaces established in schools to provide students with tools and equipment to learn and innovate.
 
• ATLs aim to nurture scientific temper and creativity among students from an early age.
 
• Over **10,000 ATLs** have been set up across India, impacting millions of students.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **NITI Aayog:**

 
 
• NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is a **policy think tank** of the Government of India, established in **2015** to replace the Planning Commission.
 
• It focuses on fostering cooperative federalism and promoting sustainable development goals (SDGs).
 
 
 
• **Innovation Ecosystem in India:**
 
 
• India has emerged as a global hub for **startups** and innovation, ranking among the top five countries in terms of the number of startups.
 
• Government initiatives like **Startup India**, **AIM**, and **Digital India** have played a pivotal role in fostering innovation.
 
• India’s **Global Innovation Index (GII)** ranking has improved significantly, reflecting its focus on research, innovation, and entrepreneurship.
 
 
 
• **Importance of AIM:**
 
 
• AIM's programs like **Atal Tinkering Labs**, **Atal Incubation Centres**, and **Mentor India Initiative** are instrumental in encouraging innovation.
 
• It serves as a platform for collaboration between government, academia, and private enterprises to solve critical challenges.
